The man voluntarily entered a coffin for a planned buried-coffin escape stunt. He knew there was already a corpse inside, but not whose it was. A deceased person involved in the stunt was supposed to remove the earth above the coffin. When the man lit a match and recognized the corpse, he realized that person could no longer do the planned digging. The remaining crew did not know he was inside the buried coffin, so they did not rescue him. He died trapped underground; recognizing the corpse made him understand the danger and feel hopeless, but did not itself kill him.
